name: qiaomu-opencli-autofix
title_zh: OpenCLI 命令失败时自动诊断并修复适配器
tagline_zh: 命令一崩，它不让你干瞪眼——自动走诊断、打补丁、重试三步。专治适配器报错，任何 AI 代理都能挂上。
tagline_en: When OpenCLI commands break, this skill walks you through diagnose-patch-retry instead of staring at errors.
desc_en: Automatically fix broken OpenCLI adapters when commands fail. Load this skill when an opencli command fails — it guides you through diagnosing the failure via OPENCLI_DIAGNOSTIC, patching the adapter, and retrying. Works with any AI agent.
why_zh: 把 OPENCLI_DIAGNOSTIC 的排查路径固化成可复用流程，不是给答案。
why_en: Turns OPENCLI_DIAGNOSTIC into a repeatable repair loop—not just answers, but a step-by-step dissection of adapter failures.
limit_zh: 只修 OpenCLI 适配器本身的故障；不处理网络、权限、依赖缺失。若诊断输出不含适配器堆栈，它会停住并让你手动介入。
limit_en: Fixes only OpenCLI adapter faults; not network, permissions, or missing deps. Stops and asks for manual help if diagnostics lack adapter stack traces.
